Upgrade your data center network with the FINISAR FTLC9551REPM 100GBase-SR4 QSFP28 Optical Transceiver, now available in refurbished condition at D CORE. This high-performance 100Gbps module is designed for short-range, high-density 100G Ethernet applications using MMF (Multimode Fiber) and MTP/MPO connectors.


Built for reliability and seamless integration, the FTLC9551REPM delivers exceptional speed and efficiency for switches, routers, and high-bandwidth data center environments.

Key Features


  • 100Gbps high-speed performance for modern data center and enterprise networks
  • QSFP28 form factor for high-density switch compatibilit
  • 850nm wavelength VCSEL laser for stable multimode fiber transmission
  • Supports MTP/MPO-12 connector for easy plug-and-play deployment
  • MMF compatibility – OM3 up to 70m, OM4 up to 100m
  • Low power consumption and excellent thermal performance
  • Digital Diagnostics Monitoring (DDM/DOM) supported
  • Refurbished, tested & verified for dependable operation
  • Ideal for Top-of-Rack, Leaf-Spine, and Data Center Backbone
